info.title: MediSync API
info.description: The MediSync partner API: speech to text, clinical notes, ICD-10-GM coding and decisions. Every generated note, code and decision is a draft that a clinician reviews and releases.

tags.name: Transcriptions
tags.description: Batch speech to text: upload a file, poll for the result.

tags.name: Live streams
tags.description: Tokens for the live WebSocket. Its messages are in the AsyncAPI document: GET /v1/asyncapi.yaml.

tags.name: Notes
tags.description: Structured notes and letters from a transcript. Every output is a draft.

tags.name: Decisions
tags.description: Answers to defined questions about a clinical state.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Usage and cost of the organisation.

get.description: Upgrade to a WebSocket at `wss://api.medisync.me/v1/audio/stream`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer msk_…` or a stream token in `?token=mst_…`. The messages are described in the AsyncAPI document (GET /v1/asyncapi.yaml, any API key). A refused handshake answers with HTTP status and the usual error body.

101.description: Switching protocols. The stream is open.

401.description: The API key is missing, not valid, revoked or expired.

403.description: The key lacks the scope, the IP is not allowed, or the key or organisation is disabled.

429.description: The project has reached its concurrent stream limit (`concurrent_streams_exceeded`) or rate limit.

500.description: An error on our side. Retry, then contact support with the request ID.

503.description: A service is busy or down. Wait for `retry-after` seconds.

bearerAuth.description: A secret API key from the console: `msk_live_…` or `msk_test_…`.

MediSyncVersion.name: MediSync-Version
MediSyncVersion.description: The API version. Without it, the version pinned to your organisation applies. Supported: 2026-11-01.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Any unique string, at most 255 characters. The answer is stored for 24 hours per project and replayed for a retry with the same key and body.

RequestId.description: The ID of this request. Quote it to support.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed per minute for this product and project.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

RateLimitReset.description: Time until the allowance is full again, in seconds with an `s` suffix.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before a retry.

type.description: The class of error. Switch on this in code.

code.description: The exact reason. Stable; listed on the errors page.

message.description: A sentence for a person. It can change; do not parse it.

param.description: The parameter or header the error is about, if any.

request_id.description: The same as the outer `request_id`. MediSync Connect errors carry it only here, so read `error.request_id` to handle both.

token.description: Single-use token for one live stream. Pass it as `?token=` on the WebSocket URL.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the token expires if it is not used.

file.description: The audio file. At most 100 MB and 2 hours (7,200 s) of audio. WAV with 16-bit PCM is the tested format; FLAC, MP3, M4A and Ogg are decoded with FFmpeg. Stereo is mixed to mono.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the spoken language, lower case, without region. Without it the language is detected.

max_speakers.description: The most speakers to separate. Values above 8 count as 8.

speaker_roles.description: Label each speaker as doctor, patient, companion, staff or other. Needs `diarization`.

terms.description: A JSON array of words to spell correctly, such as drug names: `["Ramipril","Metoprolol"]`. At most 500 terms of 2 to 80 characters. A value that is not a JSON array is ignored.

SpeakerRoles.description: Role per speaker label. Present when `speaker_roles` was requested.

status.description: `expired`: the result was kept for its retention time (1 hour after completion) and is gone.

message.const: The audio could not be transcribed. Check the file format.

text.example: Ihr Blutdruck liegt heute bei 145 zu 90. Seit gestern.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the audio. This is the billed quantity.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the file.

end.description: Seconds from the start of the file.

speaker.description: Speaker label, `speaker0` to `speaker7`, as in a live stream.

text.example: Ihr Blutdruck liegt heute bei 145 zu 90.

attribution.example: Die Erstellung erfolgt unter Verwendung der maschinenlesbaren Fassung des Bundesinstituts für Arzneimittel und Medizinprodukte (BfArM).

CodeResult.description: Suggestions for a clinician. Codes are drafts until a clinician releases them.

status.description: `accepted`: confident enough to insert into the document. `suggested`: show it to the clinician to pick. `rejected`: no code; see `reason`.

text.description: The span as written in the note.

kind.description: Only `diagnosis` is always coded; `symptom` and `finding` depend on `symptom_mode`.

negated.description: A negated mention is rejected with `negated`.

past.description: History of: swaps an acute event or past substance use for its history code. A chronic disease keeps its code, so check `title`.

queries.description: Up to 8 paraphrases in catalogue wording. They raise recall the most.

patient.description: Filters codes restricted by sex or age.

min_score.description: Candidates below this score are dropped.

symptom_mode.description: `off` rejects symptom and finding mentions as `not_a_diagnosis`.

product.description: Only products with a price. Connect calls are in `/v1/usage`, never here.

amount.description: EUR net, six decimal places, at the rates your invoice uses. The invoice rounds once per line, so a month can differ from the sum of its days by up to a cent per line.

Decision.description: A draft for a clinician, not a clinical decision.

noul.description: Probability that the statement is true.

score.description: Expected level, from 0 to the number of levels minus 1. 1.84 lies between level 1 and 2.

state.description: The clinical state to decide on: any JSON value, such as a note or a structured record.

questions.description: 1 to 64 questions, keyed by your question ID.

type.description: `noul`: a yes-or-no statement; the answer is the probability that it is true. `choice`: one of 2 to 255 options. `score`: a level on a scale of 2 to 16 levels, numbered from 0 in the order of `criteria`.

instructions.description: The question. Without it the question ID is used.
instructions.example: Muss der Patient heute noch gesehen werden?

criteria.description: `noul`: `{true, false}` descriptions. `choice`: `{option: description}`, 2 to 255 entries. `score`: level descriptions, 2 to 16.

images.description: Up to 4 data URLs (PNG, JPEG, WebP), 10 MB each. `ms-decide-mini` accepts no images.

metadata.description: Up to 8 entries. Only `purpose` is logged.

DecisionBatch.description: One entry per request, in request order.

Letter.description: A draft. A clinician reviews and releases it.

status.description: Always `success`. A letter that fails is an error answer, 503 `service_unavailable`, and is not billed.

markdown.description: The document text as Markdown. At most 20,000 characters are read.

notes.description: The clinical notes the letter is written from.
notes.example: 67 J., w. Hypertonie seit 2019. RR 145/90. Ramipril 5 mg 1-0-0.

encounter_id.description: Your ID for the patient encounter, 1 to 128 characters: letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `:` or `-`. Calls 1 to 3 with the same ID and the same transcript are billed as one encounter. The count resets 30 days after the last call.

api.description: The API that runs the model.

base.description: The model the ID runs on.

Note.description: A draft. A clinician reviews and releases it.

model.description: The model that read the transcript. Set also when every field comes back `not_mentioned`. When no field went to a model (for example every field has source `system`, or `sections` selects none), no model ran and this can be empty.

Form.description: The template: sections and fields to fill. The number of fields has no limit of its own; a large form takes several model calls. The request body can be at most 5 MiB.

source.description: Where the value comes from: `conversation` (what was said, the default), `measurement` (a measured value said aloud) or `system` (your system fills it, such as the patient name; never filled here).

negation.description: Option values for yes and no on a `boolean` or `choice` field.

applies_to.description: Skip the section for patients outside these bounds.

transcript.description: The conversation. Either plain text with one segment per line, or a list of segments. The `text` of a transcription result works as is.

text.example: Wie geht es Ihnen seit der letzten Kontrolle?

sections.description: Section IDs to fill. The other sections come back as `not_mentioned`.

patient.description: Used only to skip sections with `applies_to`. Never sent to the model.

context.description: Background for the model. Values are never copied from it.

wordbook.description: Spellings applied to the transcript before the model reads it. At most 60 entries.

encounter_id.description: Your ID for the patient encounter, 1 to 128 characters: letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `:` or `-`. Calls 1 to 3 with the same ID and the same transcript are billed as one encounter. The count resets 30 days after the last call.

product.description: `connect.*` counts one request per metered Connect call. Connect is billed per active user and connector, so these rows never appear in `/v1/costs`.
